summary.text: Brit McKenzie is a Republican state representative from Arkansas House District 7 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. McKenzie has worked in marketing and advertising, including as a brand manager with Walmart.

paragraphs.text: McKenzie was born in Fayetteville, Arkansas, and earned a B.A. in government from Hampden-Sydney College in 2013.
His career experience includes working as a brand manager with Walmart, a senior account manager with Saatchi and Saatchi X, and an account executive with VMLY&R.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, McKenzie said his public service began as a legislative aide on Capitol Hill and that he later worked for the Republican Party of Virginia and the Republican National Committee.
McKenzie assumed office in the Arkansas House on January 9, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session McKenzie was vice chair of the House Education Committee and also served on the House City, County and Local Affairs Committee, the House Rules Committee and the Boys State Committee.
In the 2022 survey, McKenzie listed economic development and higher-paying jobs, school choice, and taxes and government over-regulation as his key campaign messages.
